name: Bely smysl chyornykh slov
source:
"What people believe in isn't felt by them as faith; they simply think that's how the world is. We are standing in a small pioneer camp, where Semyon Persunov has been given the role of the protagonist. Everyone else lives in a world where Semyon is their only way to touch...
If the reader thinks that moral values now forbid him from following every word of his 'avatar,' then he is trying to do the right thing in the way he understands it, in the world he thinks he lives in.
You've told me many times that I look down on others too much.
But if I expected too much from them, if I expected people to understand everything correctly, I would hate them altogether. It's not their fault that they are crazy.
I know this is harder for you than it would be for me. But remember, in the end, the real culprit will be exposed. The truth will come out, and everyone who was sure of the wrong thing will end up looking foolish."

This is a short story about why Miku is the only correct way out for the protagonist.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2900972026]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“人们所相信的东西并不被他们认为是信仰；他们只是认为世界就是这样。我们正站在一个小先锋营地，谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫被赋予了主角的角色。其他人生活在一个谢苗是他们唯一接触方式的世界……
如果读者认为道德价值观现在禁止他遵循他的“化身”的每一个字，那么他正在尝试以他理解的方式，在他认为自己生活的世界中做正确的事情。
你多次告诉我，我太看不起别人了。
但如果我对他们期望过高，如果我期望人们正确理解一切，我就会完全讨厌他们。他们疯狂不是他们的错。
我知道这对你来说比对我来说更难。但请记住，最终，真正的罪魁祸首将会被揭露。真相终将大白，所有确信错误的人最终都会显得愚蠢。”

这是一个关于为什么Miku是主角唯一正确出路的短篇故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2900972026]Steam[/url]]
